title: ESG & Compliance
subtitle: Manage measurement definitions for sustainability and compliance inspections.
empty: No indicators yet. Create a measurement definition to link recurring inspections.

setup.title: Getting started
steps: Ask a superuser to enable the ESG module (Platform → Tenants).
Create an indicator here (e.g. Gas m³, type Number).
Create a recurring issue with a unit and select the indicator in step 1.
Assign a team in step 2 so the task appears on the unit QR portal.
Complete the task on the portal with a reading — it will show under Measurements.

measurements.subtitle: Review field readings for audits and reporting.

setup.title: Record your first reading
steps: Create an indicator on the Indicators tab first.
Create a recurring issue with a unit and linked indicator.
Complete the task via the unit QR portal and enter the reading.
Return here — or use the API (esg:create) for external sources.
